Far away, in another world, there is a city where it’s almost always winter. In this city lives an orphan boy who owns a snowflake-shaped amulet. Help the boy find his family. To do so, you will have to turn many pages of his story. Discover six chapters that capture the spirit of winter holidays, filled with story-rich illustrations for everyone’s taste.

notes.title: Gems of Destiny: Toymaker's Quest
notes.content:
[u][h2][url=https://www.bigfishgames.com/us/en/games/17129/gems-of-destiny-toymakers-quest/?pc&lang=en]Play free Demo, no registration needed[/url][/h2][/u]


This year, Santa Claus has received so many letters from all around the world that even Santa's magical workshop is struggling to keep up. As the best Toymaker, Santa has entrusted you with building the Village of Artisans to produce a multitude of toys and decorations on time! Battle the Snow Monsters, fend off attacks from the Evil Cloud, and fulfill Santa's tasks in this colorful New Year game 'Gems of Destiny: Toymaker's Quest.'


[list]
[*] Build 27 workshops to help Santa!
[*] Fight Evil Cloud and Snow Monsters in Hard Mode
[*] 100 challenging levels
[*] New Endless Mode! Test your skills in Endless Challenge
[/list]

notes.title: Beyond Stories: Jester - Available Now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295280/Beyond_Stories_Jester/

I want to tell you a story… story about the Jester. Can you break free from the trap set by the strange Jester, who is always laughing? What encounters await you in the Jester's world? What will you remember, and what adventures will you experience? Piece together the puzzle bit by bit and emerge victorious in the battle.

A mix of dark story with intriguing twists and a puzzle, where all the pictures support the atmosphere of the story.

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reveal 6 puzzle chapters including 1 Bonus Chapter, full of atmospheric pictures
[*] Incredible different themed pictures – Dark Arts, Fallen Memories, Music of Autumn, Fright Stories, Haunted Phantoms and more.
[*] Reveal the dark and heart touching story with thematic 132 puzzle pictures
[*] A lot of options to adjust puzzles - rotation, size, cutout shapes etc.
[*] Great puzzle sizes - up to 1000 pieces
[/list]
